<\STATESEP>theory Corres_Adjust_Preconds

  "Corres_UL"

begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>named_theorems corres_adjust_precond_structures<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>locale corres_adjust_preconds begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  preconds :: "bool \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "preconds A B C D = (A \<and> B \<and> C \<and> D)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  finalise_preconds :: "bool \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "finalise_preconds A = True"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma consume_preconds:
  "preconds A True True True \<Longrightarrow> A"
  "preconds True B True True \<Longrightarrow> B"
  "preconds True True C True \<Longrightarrow> C"
  "preconds True True True D \<Longrightarrow> D"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. ((preconds A True True True \<Longrightarrow> A) &&& (preconds True B True True \<Longrightarrow> B)) &&& (preconds True True C True \<Longrightarrow> C) &&& (preconds True True True D \<Longrightarrow> D)<\STATESEP>by (simp_all add: preconds_def)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemmas consume_preconds_True = consume_preconds(1)[where A=True]<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma split_preconds_left:
  "preconds (A \<and> A') (B \<and> B') (C \<and> C') (D \<and> D') \<Longrightarrow> preconds A B C D"
  "preconds (A \<and> A') (B \<and> B') (C \<and> C') True \<Longrightarrow> preconds A B C True"
  "preconds (A \<and> A') (B \<and> B') True True \<Longrightarrow> preconds A B True True"
  "preconds (A \<and> A') True True True \<Longrightarrow> preconds A True True True"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)

  "preconds (A \<and> A') (B \<and> B') (C \<and> C') (D \<and> D') \<Longrightarrow> preconds A' B' C' D'"
  "preconds (A \<and> A') (B \<and> B') (C \<and> C') True \<Longrightarrow> preconds A' B' C' True"
  "preconds (A \<and> A') (B \<and> B') True True \<Longrightarrow> preconds A' B' True True"
  "preconds (A \<and> A') True True True \<Longrightarrow> preconds A' True True True"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. ((preconds (A \<and> A') (B \<and> B') (C \<and> C') (D \<and> D') \<Longrightarrow> preconds A' B' C' D') &&& (preconds (A \<and> A') (B \<and> B') (C \<and> C') True \<Longrightarrow> preconds A' B' C' True)) &&& (preconds (A \<and> A') (B \<and> B') True True \<Longrightarrow> preconds A' B' True True) &&& (preconds (A \<and> A') True True True \<Longrightarrow> preconds A' True True True)<\STATESEP>by (simp_all add: preconds_def)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma preconds_goal_initiate:
  "preconds A B C D \<Longrightarrow> (preconds A B C D \<Longrightarrow> Q)
    \<Longrightarrow> finalise_preconds (A \<and> B \<and> C \<and> D) \<Longrightarrow> Q"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. \<lbrakk>preconds A B C D; preconds A B C D \<Longrightarrow> Q; finalise_preconds (A \<and> B \<and> C \<and> D)\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> Q<\STATESEP>by simp<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma finalise_preconds:
  "finalise_preconds True"
  "finalise_preconds A \<Longrightarrow> finalise_preconds B \<Longrightarrow> finalise_preconds (A \<and> B)"
  "finalise_preconds X"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. finalise_preconds True &&& (\<lbrakk>finalise_preconds A; finalise_preconds B\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> finalise_preconds (A \<and> B)) &&& finalise_preconds X<\STATESEP>by (simp_all add: finalise_preconds_def)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma corres_adjust_pre:
  "corres_underlying R nf nf' rs P Q  f f'
    \<Longrightarrow> (\<And>s s'. (s, s') \<in> R \<Longrightarrow> preconds (P1 s) (Q1 s') True True \<Longrightarrow> P s)
    \<Longrightarrow> (\<And>s s'. (s, s') \<in> R \<Longrightarrow> preconds (Q2 s') (P2 s) True True \<Longrightarrow> Q s')
    \<Longrightarrow> corres_underlying R nf nf' rs (\<lambda>s. P1 s \<and> P2 s) (\<lambda>s'. Q1 s' \<and> Q2 s') f f'"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):

P1 s \<and> P2 s) (\<lambda>s'. Q1 s' \<and> Q2 s') f f'<\STATESEP>apply (erule stronger_corres_guard_imp)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)

 1. \<And>s s'. \<lbrakk>\<And>s s'. \<lbrakk>(s, s') \<in> R; preconds (P1 s) (Q1 s') True True\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> P s; \<And>s s'. \<lbrakk>(s, s') \<in> R; preconds (Q2 s') (P2 s) True True\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> Q s'; P1 s \<and> P2 s; Q1 s' \<and> Q2 s'; (s, s') \<in> R\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> P s
 2. \<And>s s'. \<lbrakk>\<And>s s'. \<lbrakk>(s, s') \<in> R; preconds (P1 s) (Q1 s') True True\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> P s; \<And>s s'. \<lbrakk>(s, s') \<in> R; preconds (Q2 s') (P2 s) True True\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> Q s'; P1 s \<and> P2 s; Q1 s' \<and> Q2 s'; (s, s') \<in> R\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> Q s'<\STATESEP>apply (simp add: preconds_def)+<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal:
No subgoals!<\STATESEP>done<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>ML \<open>

structure Corres_Adjust_Preconds = struct

val def_intros = @{thms conjI pred_conjI}

(* apply an intro rule, splitting preconds assumptions to
   provide unique assumptions for each goal. *)
fun intro_split ctxt intros i =
  ((resolve_tac ctxt intros
        THEN_ALL_NEW (TRY o assume_tac ctxt))
    THEN_ALL_NEW (fn j => (EVERY (replicate (j - i) (dresolve_tac ctxt @{thms split_preconds_left} j)))
        THEN dresolve_tac ctxt @{thms split_preconds_right} j)) i

fun handle_preconds ctxt intros =
  TRY o (eresolve_tac ctxt [@{thm preconds_goal_initiate}]
    THEN' REPEAT_ALL_NEW (eresolve_tac ctxt @{thms consume_preconds_True}
        ORELSE' intro_split ctxt (intros @ def_intros)
        ORELSE' eresolve_tac ctxt @{thms consume_preconds})
    THEN' REPEAT_ALL_NEW (resolve_tac ctxt @{thms finalise_preconds})
  )

fun mk_adj_preconds ctxt intros rule = let
    val xs = [rule] RL (Named_Theorems.get ctxt @{named_theorems corres_adjust_precond_structures})
    val x = case xs of
        [] => raise THM ("no unifier with corres_adjust_precond_structures", 1, [rule])
      | xs => hd xs
  in x
    |> ALLGOALS (handle_preconds ctxt intros)
    |> Seq.hd
    |> Simplifier.simplify (clear_simpset ctxt addsimps @{thms conj_assoc simp_thms(21-22)})
  end

val setup =
      Attrib.setup @{binding "adj_corres"}
          ((Attrib.thms -- Args.context)
              >> (fn (intros, ctxt) => Thm.rule_attribute [] (K (mk_adj_preconds ctxt intros))))
          "use argument theorems to adjust a corres theorem."

end

  assumes my_corres: "corres_underlying my_sr nf nf' rvrel P Q a c"
